_comment: Copy this to rp-config.json beside Scripts/main.lua. The mod creates one with these defaults if it is missing, so you only need this file if you want to change something.
_caFile: Only needed if the backend runs on a home machine behind a router, where Let's Encrypt cannot validate and Caddy issues its own certificate. Point this at the exported local-ca.crt. Leave empty for a public-IP host, which is what the URL above is.
_positionHz: How often to report position. The server drops anything above 5/sec, so there is nothing to gain past that.
_channels: Slot mapping for /1 through /10. Channels travel by name; the numbers are purely a client-side shortcut. Join a channel with /channel join <name> before its slot does anything.
_rememberPassword: Stores your password in this file in the clear. Off by default. Only turn it on if you accept that.
